paragraphs: R' Shmuel bar Funia. In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, ט:, R' Yudan said in the name of R' Shmuel bar Funia, in the name of Bar Kappara; there, in the glosses of רש״ב, several variant readings are cited.

notes.text: The source heading and body read פוניא (Funia), while the catalog label reads סוניא. The catalog is unchanged. The initials רש״ב and the exact locator ט: remain unresolved.

The frozen source heading/body read Funia (פוניא); the catalog label has Sunia (סוניא), and that catalog remains unchanged. This parallel notice is retained as a distinct source version from research130. Shmuel is supplied by the source heading for ר״ש; the personal title remains R'. ט: and רש״ב remain unresolved; no uninspected Buber commentary or title identification is admitted.

Solomon Buber’s Lyck edition of Pesikta de-Rav Kahana (1868, fol. 9b) names Shmuel bar Funia in the chain from Yudan to Bar Kappara and gives variants in note קסד. In the consulted Mandelbaum text (section 1), Shmuel bar Nachman appears in place of Shmuel bar Funia, and R. Chonaya appears before Bar Kappara. Hyman’s print on p. 1146 also reads Funia. The Sunia catalogue label belongs to this separate record.
